sections.title: Grading the Pain
sections.content:
To express how severe an ache is, place adverbs directly after *duele* or *duelen*:
- **Me duele mucho**: It hurts a lot
- **Me duele bastante**: It hurts quite a bit
- **Me duele un poco**: It hurts a little
- **No me duele nada**: It doesn't hurt at all

items.spanish: Me duele mucho la cabeza y estoy mareado.
items.english: My head hurts a lot and I feel dizzy.

items.spanish: Solo me duele un poco la garganta.
items.english: My throat only hurts a little bit.

items.spanish: Meg está un poco resfriada hoy.
items.english: Meg has a bit of a cold today.

sections.content: Adjectives describing physical states (*mareado, resfriado, cansado*) change ending (-o / -a) to agree with the speaker's gender!
